exposure: Place of birth (tertiary-level obstetric unit vs. home)
place of birth (tertiary-level obstetric unit vs. home)
outcome: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vertex birth, ventouse delivery, forceps delivery, caesarean section)
Complications during the third stage of labour
cohort: 2014 women with low-risk pregnancies who delivered at University Women's Hospital Magdeburg between January 2010 and December 2014
finding: Tertiary-level obstetric unit is a safe place of birth for women with low-risk pregnancies, with low rates of perinatal and maternal complications.
mod_finding: Compared to home births, the tertiary unit had lower rates of forceps deliveries and third/fourth degree perineal trauma but higher rates of spontaneous vertex birth, epidural analgesia, and episiotomy.
